title: The Levirate Law and the Sandal
description: A law concerning levirate marriage: When a man dies without children, his brother must marry the widow so that the firstborn son may carry on the name of the deceased. If the brother refuses, the widow shall go to the elders at the city gate. There she shall pull the sandal from his foot, spit in his face, and say, 'This is what is done to a man who will not build up his brother's house.' His family line shall be known as "the house of him whose sandal was pulled off".
